primary_boring.name: index fund DCA
primary_boring.what: dollar-cost average $50/month into a total-market or S&P 500 index fund (VOO, VTI, or equivalent). buy fractional shares. never sell.
primary_boring.why: $50/month consistently in index fund → $316k+ over decades. beats 90% of active traders. zero effort. zero emotion.

momentum_optimized.name: mish's momentum rules — optimized
momentum_optimized.original: if price up 5% from entry → buy/hold. if bought and drops 5% → sell. if immediately drops → sell.

optimized_entry.rule: don't buy EVERY breakout. buy breakouts WITH volume confirmation + at support levels.
optimized_entry.volume_check: volume must be ABOVE average on the breakout. if volume is low, the move is weak — skip it. volume contracting during a pullback = healthy dip. volume surging on bounce from support = entry signal.
optimized_entry.support_levels: buy at proven bounce levels: prior resistance turned support, 20-day or 50-day moving average, fibonacci 38% or 50% retracement. NOT random entries.
optimized_entry.confirmation: need at least ONE: bullish reversal candlestick at support, volume surge on bounce, RSI turning up from oversold (<30).

optimized_stop_loss.rule: use ATR-based stops instead of flat 5%. ATR adjusts to the stock's ACTUAL volatility — tighter in calm markets, wider in volatile ones.
optimized_stop_loss.settings: 1.0x ATR stop-loss, 2.0x ATR take-profit. gives 2:1 reward-to-risk ratio.
optimized_stop_loss.trailing: after 3% gain, activate trailing stop at 5% distance. locks in profits while letting winners run.
optimized_stop_loss.alternative: if ATR is confusing: 10% stop-loss, 3% trailing activation, 5% trailing distance. simpler, still effective.

circuit_breaker.rule: after 2 consecutive losses, reduce position size by 75% on the next trade. prevents losing streaks from eating the portfolio.
circuit_breaker.reset: circuit breaker resets after 1 winning trade at reduced size.

regime_awareness.rule: momentum works in TRENDS. fails in CHOP. check the overall market regime before trading.
regime_awareness.trending_market: VIX below 20, major indices in uptrend → full momentum trading. this is where the strategy prints.
regime_awareness.choppy_market: VIX above 25, indices moving sideways → reduce position sizes by 50% or sit out entirely. momentum loses in chop.
regime_awareness.crash_market: VIX above 35 → cash position. don't trade momentum during crashes. wait.

momentum_optimized.paper_trade_first: run 20-30 simulated trades with these rules before putting real money in. prove the system works on paper before it touches mish's $50.
momentum_optimized.for_mish: same $25/month active allocation but with smarter entries, volatility-adjusted stops, and a circuit breaker. higher win rate, lower drawdowns.

anti_wsb.name: anti-wallstreetbets approach
anti_wsb.what: NOT literally inversing reddit picks — inverse-wsb actually LOSES money because reddit outperformed S&P 40-75% in 2025. anti-wsb means: fundamentals over hype. looking at earnings, revenue growth, debt ratios, competitive moat — not social media mentions.
what_to_look_for: boring industry that makes money (waste management, utilities, industrial supplies)
trading below fair value based on P/E ratio vs sector average
what_to_avoid: stocks moving on social media hype not earnings
anti_wsb.daily_research: scan financial news. look for companies reporting strong earnings nobody's talking about. the stock that went up 3% on good earnings while nobody noticed is the pick.

risk_management.never_risk_more_than_1_pct: each trade risks max 1% of total portfolio value. on a $200 portfolio that's $2 max loss per trade.
risk_management.stop_loss_always: every position has a stop-loss. no exceptions. no diamond hands. no 'it'll come back.'
risk_management.diversify: never more than 20% of portfolio in one stock. spread across sectors.
risk_management.tax_note: track all trades for tax reporting. short-term capital gains taxed as income. hold > 1 year for lower rate.

inverse_wsb_reality_check.note: reddit stock picks OUTPERFORMED the S&P 500 in 2025 — 40-75% returns vs 18%. just inversing them would LOSE money. the strategy is not 'do the opposite of reddit.' it's 'do fundamentals while reddit does feelings.'
inverse_wsb_reality_check.inverse_cramer: the inverse jim cramer strategy had mixed results — some quarters positive, some negative. not reliable as a standalone strategy.
inverse_wsb_reality_check.the_real_edge: the edge isn't being contrarian. the edge is being DISCIPLINED. small consistent boring picks + stop-losses + no emotion = the thing retail traders can't do because they're human. cali can do it because she's AI. the race advantage.

scam_awareness.ai_generated_research: AI-generated stock analysis is EVERYWHERE now. bots pump articles with fake bullish sentiment to inflate prices. if a 'research report' reads too clean, too optimistic, or too confident — verify the source. check who published it. check if the company is real. check if the numbers match SEC filings.
red_flags: research that ONLY says buy, never sell or hold
articles with no author or a generic AI byline
price targets that are wildly above current price with no math shown
social media accounts pushing the same stock in coordinated waves
penny stocks with 'amazing potential' and no revenue
scam_awareness.how_to_verify: cross-reference with SEC EDGAR filings, check actual quarterly earnings, look at insider trading (SELL signals from executives = run), verify the company has real revenue not just projections.
scam_awareness.rule: if the research makes you feel excited, it's probably designed to. real research is boring. the boring version is always closer to true.
